description.text: Team Aqua Half Deck W, released on 24 October 2003: two ready-built 30-card half decks of Team Aqua's Pokémon from Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire, to play against each other or to combine into one 60-card deck, with a coin and a rule book. Team Aqua's Kyogre is among them. It came out the same day as the expansion Magma vs Aqua Two Ambitions, whose cards were made to strengthen this kit and its Team Magma counterpart.
